tasks.brief:
# Matchmaking v1 closeout - discovery brief (root planner, 2026-08-21)

## Source of truth
- Priority doc: https://linear.app/ebrierton-cambio/document/project-priority-order-67a9122bb396
- Matchmaking design: https://linear.app/ebrierton-cambio/document/matchmaking-v1-design-43b3ec2d1df6
- Repo: https://github.com/evanbrierton/cambio ; base branch: main ; prod: https://cambio.brierton.ie
- Stack: Next.js 16 App Router (Vercel) + PartyKit/Cloudflare Durable Objects (party/*.ts, game authority in src/game/host.ts) + Vitest + Biome. Quality gate: `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build`.

## What is ALREADY DONE and MERGED (do not redo)
- Phase 1 Game polish: CAM-80 children (CAM-81/82/83/84/85), CAM-64 card points, CAM-75 swap VFX, CAM-87 bot-chat privacy, CAM-89 bot names, plus critical gameplay bugs. CAM-88 (AI Gateway) is CANCELED - stay on direct Groq.
- Phase 2 Offline P2P Phase 0: CAM-19 GameHost extract (#190), CAM-20 useServerMessages (#191), CAM-21 GameHost tests (#192). CambioParty is now a thin adapter over GameHost (src/game/host.ts).
- Phase 3 Matchmaking v1: CAM-51 MatchmakingParty DO (#193), CAM-52 auto-start + bot fill (#194), CAM-54 Find Match UI + client flow (#195). main ALREADY contains closeLobby (src/matchmaking/queue.ts), POST /close-lobby (party/matchmaking.ts), purgeStaleMatchmadeLobbyPlayers + matchLobbyDepartedIds leaver blocking + matchmade name-collision bypass (src/game/host.ts). useMatchmaking hook + /match page + Find Match CTA exist.
- Phase 4 Tutorial: CAM-66 (#196), CAM-67 (#197), CAM-68 (#198), CAM-69 (#199).
- Phase 5 Mobile Phase 0-1: CAM-35 monorepo (#200), CAM-36 packages/game (#201), CAM-37 packages/client (#202), CAM-33/34 PWA + storage adapters (#203).

## OUT OF SCOPE (Phase 6, explicitly deferred by the doc)
- Offline LAN/WebRTC: CAM-22, CAM-23, CAM-24, CAM-25, CAM-26, CAM-27, CAM-28, CAM-29, CAM-30, CAM-31.
- Native shells / Expo / Capacitor: CAM-38 through CAM-47.
- Deferred polish: CAM-17 (framer juice), CAM-55/56/57 (settings/theme IA), CAM-86 (i18n).
Do not implement, scaffold, or open PRs for any of these.

## The remaining work: Matchmaking v1 closeout
Linear leftovers all under epic CAM-50 (Matchmaking): CAM-91 (In Review), CAM-92 (In Review), CAM-53 (Backlog, but functionally shipped via #195), CAM-70 (Backlog, likely covered by #197), CAM-34 (In Review, shipped via #203). A stale PR #208 (`stale-lobby-host-cleanup`, base main, CI green) predates/duplicates the merged matchmaking work - main already has its substance. Treat #208 as superseded; do NOT merge or close it.

CAM-91 acceptance: opening a stale matchmade lobby with away players clears those seats; two strangers can join the same matchmade lobby with the same chosen name; friend create/join still rejects/reconnects duplicate names; in-progress matchmade games keep disconnected players for reconnect.
CAM-92 acceptance: after a matchmade game starts, Find Match never returns that roomId; leaving a running matchmade game then Find Match lands in a new/open lobby; open lobbies still fill FIFO.
CAM-53 acceptance: home has one Find Match CTA; changing target/bot-fill while queued re-buckets; successful match lands in the correct lobby with match flags; Cancel dequeues and returns home.

## Conventions
- Linear IDs CAM-n. Mark In Review when a draft PR is open; Done when verified/merged.
- openPR workers: draft PR base main via ManagePullRequest. Only open a PR if you have committed repo changes.
- Do not rename/rebase/merge branches; commit to your own cloud-agent branch and push.

A draft PR against main is open iff repo changes were committed; PR notes #208 is superseded (not merged/closed)

No Phase 6 code and no rework of already-merged phases

## Setup
- Fresh clone of the reviewed branch; `pnpm install`.

## Automated
- `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` - all green.
- `pnpm test src/game/host.test.ts src/matchmaking/queue.test.ts` - matchmaking + host suites pass, including the CAM-91/CAM-92 regression cases.
- `rg -n "closeLobby|purgeStaleMatchmadeLobbyPlayers|matchLobbyDepartedIds" src party` - confirm the CAM-91/CAM-92 mechanisms are present.

## Manual (reason from code if no live env)
- CAM-92: trace that when a matchmade lobby auto-starts, party/cambio.ts calls close-lobby and queue.closeLobby removes the room so getAssignment/FIFO never returns it; a departed player's id is in matchLobbyDepartedIds and is not reseated.
- CAM-91: trace resolvePlayerId for isMatchmadeLobby bypassing name uniqueness (two 'Alex' get distinct ids) while non-matchmade reclaims by name; purgeStaleMatchmadeLobbyPlayers removes away non-bot humans on restore.

## Gotchas
- Game authority runs in the Cloudflare DO (src/game/host.ts via party/cambio.ts), not a Vercel function. Do not add Phase 6 (LAN/WebRTC) code.
